roles.name: System Owner
roles.description: Highest business authority. Controls MRR, CRM pipeline, pricing, plans, add-ons, and policies.

roles.name: Super Admin
roles.description: Technical platform & data authority. Controls search engine, scrapers, AI skills, and health.

roles.name: Operations Admin
roles.description: Daily business operations. Manages customer organizations, subscriptions, invoices, and support.

roles.name: Customer Success
roles.description: Customer success manager. Monitors usage health, renewals, and onboarding.

roles.name: Data Staff
roles.description: Automotive data specialist. Reviews scraped queue, verifies fitment, and cross-references.

roles.name: Sales Staff
roles.description: Sales specialist. Manages leads, pipeline, demos, and trial onboarding.

roles.name: Support Staff
roles.description: Technical support specialist. Resolves customer inquiries and tickets.

roles.name: Customer Member
roles.description: External organization member. Accesses parts search and cross-reference.

roles.name: Customer Owner
roles.description: External organization owner. Manages organization subscription and user seats.

roles.name: Organization Manager
roles.description: Manage organization team members, view usage analytics, and execute parts cross-references.

roles.name: Organization Owner
roles.description: Full administrative control over tenant team, subscription, API keys, and automotive parts data.

roles.name: Organization Staff
roles.description: Standard search, VIN lookup, vehicle fitment, and bookmarking workspace.
